items.title: Kirk Cousins is the first quarterback with 20 TD passes to change teams midseason
items.text: It was a crazy week for the Vikings and for quarterback Kirk Cousins.

items.title: Kirk Cousins' TD pass gives Vikings 10-0 lead on Packers
items.text: Kirk Cousins threw his first touchdown pass for the Vikings since an Oct. 29, 2023, game against the Packers.

items.title: Vikings lead Packers 17-0 after Kirk Cousins' INT overturned by replay
items.text: Kirk Cousins nearly had his first interception since his return to the Vikings.

items.title: Kirk Cousins, Vikings dominate, lead 17-0 at halftime
items.text: Kirk Cousins is back, and so are the Vikings.

items.title: Vikings pummel Packers 30-10 in Kirk Cousins' return
items.text: Cousins threw for 207 yards and two touchdowns in his first game with the team since 2023.

items.title: Emotional Kirk Cousins: "It's been a tough three years. There's more to the story being written."
items.text: In first game at Lambeau Field since tearing his Achilles tendon there, Cousins fights back tears.

items.title: 49ers lead Cowboys 24-19 in third quarter
items.text: The 49ers opened the second half with a five-play, 81-yard drive to take a 24-16 lead on the Cowboys.

items.title: Chuba Hubbard comes through on fourth down to put Panthers up 7-0
items.text: Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard is on his way to a big day in New Orleans.

items.title: Panthers take 7-0 lead into halftime in New Orleans
items.text: The Panthers got on the board midway through the second quarter against the Saints and those remained the only points of the first half in New Orleans.

items.title: Saints finally on the board, tie Panthers 7-7 in third quarter
items.text: Alvin Kamara didn't touch the ball in the first half of Sunday's game, but he finally got the ball in the third quarter and he gave the Saints their first points of the afternoon.

items.title: Panthers pull out 20-17 win in New Orleans, take lead in NFC South
items.text: NFC South football has earned a negative reputation over the last few years and Sunday's game between the Panthers and Saints didn't do much to change that, but it did push one of the teams into first place in the race to represent the division in the playoffs.

items.title: Chargers rule out Ladd McConkey for Monday night at Baltimore
items.text: It's been a disappointing season for Chargers wide receiver Ladd McConkey, and it won't get any better this week.

items.title: Blake Corum scores for sixth consecutive game, Rams lead 24-6
items.text: Blake Corum won't stop scoring, and the Rams have increased their lead early in the second half.

items.title: 49ers lead Cowboys 17-16 at halftime
items.text: The 49ers and Cowboys are in a shootout at AT&T Stadium.

items.title: Jadarian Price puts Seahawks up 14-10 in third quarter
items.text: Fernando Mendoza isn't the only rookie who has scored his first NFL touchdown in Las Vegas on Sunday.

items.title: Matthew Stafford throws two TD passes, Rams lead Cardinals 17-6 at halftime
items.text: The Rams have more injury issues to deal with on offense.

items.title: Raiders rule Brock Bowers out with an ankle injury
items.text: Raiders tight end Brock Bowers dealt with an ankle injury throughout the first half of Sunday's game against the Seahawks and he will not return to the game in the second half.

items.title: Raiders lead Seahawks 10-7 at halftime
items.text: It didn't take long for Fernando Mendoza to show that he brings a different skill set to the Raiders offense than Kirk Cousins.

items.title: Aaron Donald records first sack since coming out of retirement
items.text: The first sack of the season has come for Aaron Donald.

items.title: George Pickens' TD has Cowboys with a 10-7 lead
items.text: George Pickens is back and has his first touchdown since Oct. 26.

items.title: Deebo Samuel scores on 49ers' first drive for 7-3 lead
items.text: Deebo Samuel hadn't played since Oct. 11.

items.title: Aaron Glenn: We'll know more on Geno Smith's ankle this week
items.text: Jets quarterback Geno Smith left Sunday's game with an ankle injury and head coach Aaron Glenn didn't have any update on his condition after their 31-12 loss to the Bills.

items.title: Colts hold off Dolphins 24-22
items.text: The Dolphins had a chance for their second win this season, but two missed field goals by Zane Gonzalez and a failed 2-point conversion allowed the Colts to hold onto a 24-22 win.

items.title: Browns get another fourth-quarter comeback, defeat Texans 27-24
items.text: Cleveland is now 4-0 at home for the first time since 1963.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza's first NFL TD puts Raiders up 7-0
items.text: Fernando Mendoza helped secure a national title at Indiana with a scramble for a touchdown and his first NFL touchdown came the same way.

items.title: Jaguars improve to 7-2 with 40-23 win over Titans
items.text: The Jaguars didn't play their best game of the season today in Tennessee, but they didn't need to to beat the Titans.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes throws five TDs, Chiefs beat Falcons 35-13
items.text: Mahomes threw for five touchdowns for the first time since 2022 to help the Chiefs move to 7-2 on the season.

items.title: Bills rout Jets 31-12, improve to 5-0 on the road this season
items.text: The Bills have now won five straight games.

items.title: A.J. Brown, Amon-Ra St. Brown active for Patriots-Lions in Munich
items.text: Brown returns to the Patriots lineup after missing the last two games.

items.title: Aidan Hutchinson injured celebrating after sacking Drake Maye in Germany
items.text: The Lions' best defensive player went down after a third-and-goal sack.
